newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks advance slightly, techs extend gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks advance slightly, techs extend gains.

text.p: Wall Street shares made small gains in morning trading on Tuesday, with technology stocks extending their rally amid an optimistic outlook for second quarter earnings.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which rose only slightly yesterday despite a surge in the Nasdaq market, added around 15 points, or 0.19 percent, to 7936.

Blue chip stocks took support from a firmer long bond, which recouped losses to trade unchanged at a 6.56 percent yield. The bond market strengthened after a 0.5 percent rise in June retail sales data, viewed as non-inflationary.
The Nasdaq composite, which put in a powerful performance yesterday, kept the momentum alive by rising around nine points, or 0.61 percent, to 1533.

Among its most active issues, Intel Corp rose 1-1/2 to 80-1/4, ahead of its second quarter earnings, due out after the market close. The First Call consensus earnings estimate called for $0.90 per share compared with $0.59 per share in the year-ago quarter, on a post-split basis.
"We have a lot of technology and financial companies coming out with earnings here, and that should be the focus," Gail Dudack, chief investment strategist at UBS, said.
